Percent style encodes special characters in image src URLs

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"url_escape_style\":\"percent\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<img src=\"/img (1) <draft>.png\" alt=\"alt\">", options)
    println(result)
}
```
